title: Favorite trombonists
summary: Henry names Tommy Dorsey, Higginbotham, Roy Palmer, and his teacher Charlie Clay.

story.theme_name: Trombonists: who they heard, admired and learned from
story.community_name: Talking trombonists: who played the slide and how

blocks.x: Oh, to change the subject, do you have any favorite trombone of all the different people you've heard any place in the country? Who do you like?
Well, the trombone players I like. I like that fella Tommy Dorsey. I like that other fella Higginbottom. And I like that boy in Chicago. What we was talking about. Roy Palmer.
Roy Palmer. Yeah. I remember you mentioned to me.
Yeah, I like them fellas. And the fella would taught me he ought to play trombone. Old Charlie Clay, that man was great. He was great. He's passed on now.
